raw_segments.text: He hadn't time, Bairne. He was gone in a minute was your father. He had been a bit ailing like the day before but not to signify, and when Mr. St. John asked if he would like either o' ye to be sent for, he fair laughed at him.

He began again with a bit of a heaviness in his head the next day, that is, a fortnight's sin, and he went to sleep and never wakened. He were a most stark when your brother went into tea chamber and fanned him. Ah, Childer.

That's tea last a tea old stock, for ye and Mr. St. John is like of different sort to them at's gone, for all your mother were mich I your way, and a most as book learned. She were the pictor oh ye, Mary. Diana is more like your father.
